children: Tenaris S.A. Sponsored ADR (MIL:TEN) reported third-quarter 2026 sales of $3.1 billion and net income of $521 million, with EBITDA up 16% to $756 million, and expects fourth-quarter sales and EBITDA to increase. The company also won contracts for the Eni-led Cronos gas development offshore Cyprus.
: Tenaris (TEN) posted Q3 2026 sales of $3.1 billion, up 5% sequentially, and net income of $521 million, up 6%. EBITDA rose 16% to $756 million. It expects Q4 sales and EBITDA to increase.
: Tenaris (TEN) won contracts to supply tubular goods, line pipe and coating services for Eni-led Cronos gas development offshore Cyprus, in partnership with TotalEnergies.
: • Barclays maintained its Overweight rating on Tenaris S.A. Sponsored ADR (TEN) and raised its price target to $88 from $80.
